species.name: glass-dewberry
species.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. The attached image is the EDIT TARGET: a tall mature apothecary crop for a Stardew Valley mod. The user asks for CRISPER HARVEST PARTS AND STRONGER DARK CONTOURS, with a modest enlargement if necessary.
Change ONLY the mature harvest heads and their tiny calyces, preserve the plant's species, large spreading foliage, tall slender 1:2 overall silhouette, curved stem and open branch layout. Make the main harvest heads about 10-15% larger relative to the leaves, but keep the full plant width close to the original; use the small air gaps around each head. Each head must have a continuous clean DARK material-colored contour around its whole silhouette, including where it lies in front of green foliage. Distinct closed contours are crucial. Keep exactly the same count of harvest heads and attachment positions.
Style: simplified polished farming-game asset with clean broad solid color regions. Replace mottled soft gradients on harvest heads with a broad clear midtone, a deep colored underside, and ONE small sharply defined highlight. No cloudy reflections, fuzzy rim, glowing edge, tiny sparkles, microtexture or excessive white. Make the main body of each head substantial and easy to read after reduction to 6-7 body pixels plus a dark outline in a 16x32 crop. Heads remain separate and do not merge into a bunch. Keep stems and leaves attached; don't add objects.
Output a single complete plant, tall portrait, small transparent margins, truly transparent RGBA background. No ground, cast shadow, pot, text or frame. All leaves and harvest heads fully visible. Keep the original leaf geometry and its rich green colors.
Preserve THREE round glass BLUE BERRIES, on the high-left, mid-right and low-left branches. Every berry must stay ROUND. A firm deep NAVY closed contour, bold COBALT underside, saturated azure/blue body and a SINGLE compact cream-cyan glint on the upper-left, enough clean blue body around the glint. The berries should be a little larger, not replaced by tiny bright dots. Keep their green calyces compact and separate from the navy berry contour.
